description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Fortune Media is a company reinventing its brand in a digital-first world. They are seeking a highly motivated Full Stack Software Engineer to join their engineering team, focusing on building and maintaining high-performance, scalable systems that enhance their digital properties.
Next.js full-stack web engineer for CMS-driven sites, APIs, and analytics optimization

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions using Next.js for our front-end applications, ensuring optimal performance, accessibility, and user experience
• Build robust and scalable backend systems that integrate seamlessly with our CMS and various APIs, supporting the delivery of dynamic content and personalized experiences
• Work closely with our content teams to optimize CMS workflows, develop custom integrations, and ensure efficient content publishing across our platforms
• Leverage data analytics and A/B testing to optimize website performance and user experience. Drive data-informed decisions throughout the development lifecycle to ensure all improvements align with business goals and contribute to measurable outcomes
• Collaborate effectively with designers, product managers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into innovative technical solutions
• Continuously analyze and optimize our web applications for speed, scalability, and reliability, ensuring a seamless experience for our global audience
• Stay abreast of the latest technologies and trends in web development, particularly in the areas of Next.js, serverless architectures, and headless CMS solutions, embracing AI to remain at the forefront of innovation

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
• Proven experience building high-performance web applications using Next.js or similar framework
• Strong understanding of backend technologies and RESTful API design
• Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web development frameworks
• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
• Strong communication and collaboration skills

Preferred:
• Experience working with Content Management Systems is a plus
• Experience with ads technology, DevOps, and automation tests
